package_cost: Chrome version is free according to publisher download page; no paid API used
scope: Chrome package 5.5.1 on iPadOS 26.2 simulator; user-specific extension version and failing script not supplied
matrix_scope: Native API surface in a real extension-origin page. The probe page does not load Soulo compatibility JS. Existing shim separately provides an offscreen namespace but only fake document state, not an actual DOM document.
required_missing: native userScripts namespace (declared in required permissions)
native offscreen document (declared in required permissions)
permission_caveat: Undefined optional or undeclared APIs such as downloads, debugger and identity do not prove those APIs unsupported; their permissions were not granted for this probe.
host_access: Only local fixture origins granted. External host access was withheld. No installed user scripts, cloud account login or external-site functional certification.
conclusion: Not complete desktop WebExtension or Tampermonkey compatibility. Package installation/loading succeeds while required API gaps remain; script execution, dashboard installation, iframe behavior and persistence still require extension-specific functional testing. No production extension runtime changes made during this audit.

current_app_boundaries.native_webextensions: iOS 18.4 or later, per application availability guards and Apple WebKit platform API
current_app_boundaries.userscripts: Built-in GM compatibility is a separate runtime; synchronous resources, full sandbox/world semantics and every Tampermonkey API are not certified

causality_limit: The API gaps can explain incompatibility; the reported user installation and script were not provided, so its exact failure is not yet reproduced.
